descriptionHtml:
"WIE UNVEIL" which was organized by the IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) Student Affinity Group of University of Peradeniya was an introductory session for our newly joined volunteers to familiarize them with IEEE and IEEE WIE, emphasizing the benefits of volunteering with IEEE and how IEEE and WIE can pave the way for a successful career. This event encompassed an array of topics including an introduction to IEEE Women in Engineering, elucidation on the opportunities available through this platform, and more.

Notably, the event was conducted via an online platform to facilitate participation from individuals beyond the confines of the university premises. The session was spearheaded by Prof. Maheshi Dissanayake, Advisor of IEEE WIE SB AG of UoP. Furthermore, Ms. Michelle Perera, Chair of the IEEE WIE Student Activities Committee, IEEE WIE Sri Lanka section, graced the occasion as the distinguished guest speaker. Her contributions entailed the sharing of invaluable experiences, thereby endowing participants with a comprehensive understanding of IEEE WIE. The event secured favorable responses, attracting over 30 undergraduates who expressed keen interest in becoming part of the IEEE WIE community, thus reflecting a shared aspiration to broaden their horizons both personally and professionally.
